request.style: English, hymn, female solo voice, piano, strings, organ, warm mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The high priest carries blood of animals
Into the holy place with care
But their bodies are burned outside the camp
A ritual beyond the air
Jesus suffered outside the gate
To make the people holy and new
Through his own blood we are set apart
From the old and fading view

[Chorus]
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come
No permanent home in this world
Only the promise we have found
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come

[Verse]
Let us go out to him outside the camp
Bearing the disgrace he bore
We join him in the way of suffering
For the sake of his love forevermore
Through him we offer praise continually
The fruit of lips that confess his name
Do not neglect to do good and share
For such sacrifices please God's fame

[Chorus]
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come
No permanent home in this world
Only the promise we have found
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come

[Verse]
Obey your leaders and submit to them
They keep watch over your souls
They must give an account to God
Let their work be a joy and not a burden
Do this so it may be to your advantage
For it is of no benefit to you
Walk in faith and in obedience
Under the sky that is so blue

[Chorus]
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come
No permanent home in this world
Only the promise we have found
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come

[Outro]
For here we have no lasting city
We look for the one that is to come
